description: This PHP source file implements a user authentication class 'LDAPAuthenticateUser' for integrating LDAP authentication within the SuiteCRM system. It manages LDAP server connections, user binding, LDAP searches for user info and group memberships, and can create new user entries based on LDAP data.

classes.name: LDAPAuthenticateUser
classes.description: A class extending 'SugarAuthenticateUser' that facilitates LDAP-based user authentication, user info retrieval, LDAP binding, group membership validation, and user creation within the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: authenticateUser
methods.description: Performs LDAP server connection, binds with user credentials, retrieves user info, validates group membership, and either returns an existing user ID or creates a new user.

methods.name: getUserNameFilter
methods.description: Constructs an LDAP filter string for matching a specific username, optionally incorporating additional filter criteria.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user record in the database with info obtained from LDAP and returns the new user ID.

methods.name: loadUserOnLogin
methods.description: Manages the login process: validates LDAP extensions, initiates authentication, loads user session upon success.

methods.name: loginError
methods.description: Processes LDAP error codes, logs detailed error messages, and returns a boolean indicating error presence.

methods.name: ldap_rdn_lookup
methods.description: Performs LDAP bind and search to retrieve the distinguished name (DN) or bind user for a given login username, facilitating authentication against LDAP.
